fix: Recover bounded two-column text tables from full-width header/closing rules, continuous internal divider, centred headers and repeated aligned dot leaders.

Use source primary-column baselines and hanging wraps; preserve every word, raw leader/dash text and cell/row/header bounding boxes. Reject missing values, crossed columns, broken borders and ambiguous continuations.
Do not reinterpret existing physical/numeric/course tables. Bound edge/word/combination counts.
Native stale table caches refresh at v6; preserve fully optical v4/v5 content only with complete native/coverage proof. Preserve previous optical provenance.
Read exact v5 durable job identities; new work uses v6 so previous incomplete table work is not reused.
Reject indented leader entries or flush-left fresh values instead of merging a child row into a long parent label.

independent_reference.method: NFC + casefold + letters/digits only for cell identity/order. Exact native source word multiset retained separately. Punctuation, dot leaders, wrapping and printed dash differences are not claimed to be literal character matches.
independent_reference.exposure: Existing exposed dev cohort; original annotations/source regions inspected during diagnosis. Runtime reads only PDF geometry/text, never annotations or publisher data. Publisher text fetched and parsed separately after source-only predictions.

retrieval.note: 18 actual app retrievals were produced before the final ambiguity guard. All45 parsed/table outputs, retrieval code, request bytes and index bytes were revalidated unchanged; no redundant retrieval/model calls.
